name: Ajax loader + Cache
author: MDZ

sections.description:
This free and lightweight plugin loads all your WordPress site URLs (links) in an Ajax format (SPA: wordpress single page application) with a very modern and advanced look, this plugin has a dedicated settings page that provides you with advanced settings and also has a local-cache system that increases the loading speed of your site and minimizes the processing and consumption of your server!

🤖Best Seo-Friendly => This plugin adds only a single JS file to your site’s pages and does not alter the original HTML source code. Throughout its years of development, no conflicts or negative impacts on SEO have been observed; it is fully reliable and thoroughly tested, so you can use it with confidence.

⚡️Instant Page Fetch => Thanks to professional settings and a dedicated caching system, Ajax Loader can update your page content at lightning speed! (Guaranteed fastest speed among similar plugins!!) It is fully compatible with WordPress caching plugins Like Wp-Rocket etc…

✅FTL Enhancer System => Users arriving at your site (for instance, via Google Search) are redirected to an intermediary page instead of waiting for the full page to load; the main content loads in the background using AJAX and is then instantly swapped in for the user.

= How It Works (JavaScript Based)=
😎 Whenever a user clicks a link on your site, the Ajax loader intelligently requests the page content from the server (WordPress) in real-time; once received, it fully updates the page content using its own modules and JavaScript code.
–AJAX requests for page loading are not sent to the admin-ajax.php file; consequently, server usage will not increase.

Privacy and Security

🔴 This plugin has been developed in full compliance with WordPress security principles and optimized, secure coding practices, and has shown no security vulnerabilities to date.

🔴 User privacy is a red line for our team; therefore, under no circumstances do we transmit any data from users’ sites, and we will respect your privacy.

Frequent updates and continuous development

🔴 Our team is constantly reviewing and developing this free product; we strive to continuously monitor the plugin’s performance and improve it day by day.

💎 Compatible with most popular WordPress themes and plugins Like: Woocommerce & Elementor.

🧩Wordpress Themes: Flatsome, Woodmart, X-Store, Hello-Elementor, Flox, Avada, Astra, Wp-Ocean & etc…

🔌 WordPress Plugins: Woocommerce, EDD, Elementor (Elementor Pro), Contact-from7, Wooslider & etc…

🎨 WordPress PageBuilders: Elementor, WpBackery, Bricks, Flatsome UX-Builder, Avada Fusion-Builder, Divi Builder & etc…

⚙️ WordPress Cache Plugins: Wp-Rocket, Wp-optimize, Redis (Redis Pro), LiteSpeed Cache, W3Total-Cache, Wp fastest-cache & etc…

🌐 Browsers: Compatible with most modern browsers (capable of executing JS code and supporting the document.write method) Like: Chrome, Opera, FireFox, Edge, Yandex & More…

📱 Android/IOS Compatible: Tested and compatible with modern, up-to-date Android devices and Apple iOS.

📲 Mobile-Devices: Motorolla, Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi &…

In-browser caching system

If enabled, it temporarily stores the fetched page content statically within the user’s browser And it refreshes the cache if the cached files have expired.
💪 With this professional option, you can monitor and optimize your server resource usage during periods of high traffic!

☘️ Free & Clear: No statistical data is collected by this plugin at all!

Professional Features

— Dedicated settings page
— Includes an unminified JS file (source code is fully transparent, with no obfuscation)
— PWA-compatible
— Features engaging graphic effects for page loading.
— Maximum compatibility with popular slider builders such as Swiper (Dedicated system for detecting drag and page load failures.)
— Ability to configure and exclude <a> tags based on their CSS class or HTML attribute.

🔥 Want More?! Go pro 😎

Pro Version Features

🔴 Lazy-Loader – a very Robust Lazy-Load system that works perfectly on the images, audio, video tags (Any html tag with src attribute!) and Enhance the speed of your entire site!

🔴 Progress Bar – Visual loading indicator that informs users (Better UX).

🔴 Professional Branding Load-Effect – You can display your business logo and slogan to the user while pages are loading (Best for Branding)

🔴 Modern Page-Load system – uses JS Fetch API instead of Jquery Old XMLHttpRequest method

🔴 Modern Page-Writing system – uses modern methods instead of document.write (Still under developing)

🔴 Clean Site-Urls – Get rid of all ‘#’ signs in the users’ browser address bar after the page loads!

🔴 Exclude pages form Ajax-load – With the help of the professional page exclusion system, easily exclude any page where you do not want the Ajax loader to operate!

🔴 Professional JS files Load strategy – can use defer attribute to load all js files of this plugin also can change the fetchpriority of js files to low

🔴 Run Your JS-codes after page-load – This unique option enables you to execute your own custom JS code after & before the page loads via Ajax.

🧪 Experimental Features – In the Pro version, you can test and use new experimental features and help us improve this product.

🔴 Help & Support – Life time advanced support + solve issues and bugs on your site

🙏 Support us – Dear User: Keep in mind that purchasing and using the Pro version of this plugin is a significant support from you, and has a significant impact on the development and future of this free plugin!

Incompatibilities & Bugs

👾 Please report any bugs or incompatibilities you encounter to our email address or our team’s Telegram ID.
mdesign.fa@gmail.com
@g_mdz

😬 In general, if the JavaScript code on your site follows standard practices, the Ajax loader is guaranteed to work without any issues or incompatibilities.

What is meant by standard JS coding for WordPress? => In general, to avoid any disruptions, bugs, or compatibility issues, you should not define any JavaScript variables (let, const) globally.
Example-1 (Standard Coding)
✅ var my_desired_js_var = 1; //No-problem at-all
❌ let my_desired_js_var = 1; //If it is defined globally, it can cause problems because it cannot be redefined.
❌ const my_desired_js_const = 1; //If it is defined globally, it can cause problems because it cannot be redefined.

Example-2 (Standard Coding)
✅(()=>{
class my_class {
//Etc…
}
});//No-problem at-all

❌ class my_class {
//Etc…
};//If it is defined globally, it can cause problems because it cannot be redefined.

Note: In general, after an AJAX page load, any JavaScript variable or class that cannot be redefined may cause issues (It mostly causes UI issues; it does not involve critical, security, or SEO-related problems.)

Error-text Example (Chrome Browser Console): Failed to execute ‘define’ on ‘CustomElementRegistry’: the name “wc-order-attribution-inputs” has already been used with this registry

Important note: You can manually resolve the issues that arise by changing the let and const variables to var.

🤩 Our team is currently exploring new, optimized, and sustainable methods to fully resolve this incompatibility in a standard manner within future versions; we appreciate your patience.

Updates

Update only from the official WordPress plugin repository

Look for the settings page named as (Ajax Loader) of this plugin in the WordPress tools section

Support

Unfortunately, support for this plugin is not available at this moment, but we promise you that if your site and especially the JS files of the front part of your site have standard coding, no bugs or errors will occur

sections.installation:
To install the plugin, just search the term js loader OR ajax loader in the wordpress repository!
